notes.title: OtherSoul 3.0
notes.content:
We are just two guys who play the game in our spare time and want to make it better and better. We've got the enthusiasm to do it, we hope the game will do something for everyone! Thank you for your support! :)

We've completely overhauled the smaller, larger parts of the game, from the main menu to the end of the game.

Contents of update 3.0:
- new assets 
- new and higher resolution models included
- new enemy models
- new gameplay elements
- new map sections
- upgraded sounds and effects
- camera function
- bug fixes
- and much more...

Thank you so much for playing OtherSoul and supporting our work. We continue to work on making our game even more atmospheric and enjoyable! <3

notes.title: OtherSoul 2.0 Hotfix
notes.content: We are constantly developing the game. Thank you in advance for your feedback!

notes.title: OtherSoul 2.0
notes.content:
Of course, we plan to continue to develop the game: 

Contents of update 2.0: 
- Remastered graphics
- New, higher resolution models included
- New monster model
- Reworked Sanity system 
- New map section 
- New story elements
- New storyline
- A total of 4 endings to the game
- Dialogue system
- New sounds/songs
- Use of new effects 
- Bug fixes 

And of course much more. The list above is just the tip of the iceberg

notes.title: 1.14 - Update
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support so far. Based on the feedback we've received, here's the next patch for the game, which includes a number of new features to make your gaming experience even better. We will continue to expand and improve the OtherSoul game. 

The patch includes the following changes: 
- AI Nerf
- AI slows down when you point the flashlight at it
- Adding new sounds and reworking many old sounds
- New Horror elements 
- Game optimization 
- Fix bugs
